title: Rc Plane Zone Flight Academy
subtitle: Master the art of RC aviation step-by-step.

modules.title: Ground Control & Pre-Flight Verification
modules.summary: Essential safety routines, battery voltage checks, CG balancing, and radio range testing.
topics: Transmitter power sequence (Radio ON first, then connect battery)
Control surface direction check (Aileron, Elevator, Rudder)
Finding center of gravity at 65mm from wing leading edge
Assessing wind speed (< 12 mph recommended for first flights)

modules.title: First Takeoff & Trim Control
modules.summary: Hand-launch vs ground takeoff, smooth throttle ramp up, and setting flight trims.
topics: Hand launching directly into the wind at 75% throttle
Smooth climb out at 15-degree pitch angle
Trimming elevator for level cruise at 50% throttle

modules.title: Basic Flying Patterns & Orientation
modules.summary: Flying the 'Figure 8' pattern, handling head-on orientation, and altitude control.
topics: Gentle coordinated turns with rudder and aileron
Maintaining constant 100 ft altitude during banking turns
Overcoming reverse control instinct when flying towards yourself
Utilizing the 1-Click Panic Switch when disoriented

modules.title: Approach & Touchdown Precision
modules.summary: Setting up the final landing pattern, throttling down, flare mechanics, and grass rollouts.
topics: Downwind, base, and final approach legs
Throttling back to 25% for a steady glide slope
Gentle elevator flare 1 foot above runway surface

preflightChecklist: Flight battery fully charged (12.6V total for 3S)
Radio transmitter ON before connecting aircraft LiPo
VT-Stabilize gyro calibration complete (aircraft held still on flat ground for 5 sec)
Control surfaces move in correct direction (Ailerons bank left/right, Elevator pitches up/down)
Battery hatch magnetically latched and locked
Wind direction identified (Always take off and land directly into the wind)
